feed.title: Reducing Bitcoin Full Node Storage Without Consensus Changes

entry.title: Reducing Bitcoin Full Node Storage Without Consensus Changes
entry.summary:
The exploration of database performance, particularly between RocksDB and LevelDB, is underway, though not yet complete. The preliminary assessment hints at potentially similar outcomes for both databases, although definitive results are pending the execution of detailed benchmarks. A noteworthy aspect of RocksDB is its capability to handle historical lookups of heavily compressed data, a feature touted as a key advantage.
Planning and strategizing the benchmark tests are crucial to avoid hardware limitations like drive controller saturation that could skew results. The approach involves careful consideration of the setup, including whether or not to conduct tests on multiple nodes within a single machine simultaneously. This decision will significantly influence the accuracy and reliability of the benchmarking outcomes. The next steps involve a thorough examination and comparison once the benchmarks are conducted.
